literal: God she worships not; husband having worshipped she who rises, 'rain' saying, will rain the rain.
translation: If a wife who does not worship God, but wakes up worshipping her husband, commands it to rain, the rain will fall.
modern: தெய்வத்தை வணங்காமல் தன் கணவனையே தொழுது துயிலெழும் மனைவி, பெய் என்று சொன்னால் மழையும் பெய்யும்.
explanation: This couplet illustrates the immense moral power of a devoted wife. It states that a woman who directs her reverence entirely toward her husband rather than other deities possesses such virtue that nature itself obeys her. The phrase 'பெய்யெனப் பெய்யும்' shows that her steadfast loyalty grants her words the power to command the rain.
